stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The old photo was not just a memory of past disaster.”?
options: Faster roads can connect places, but they can also cause people to pass by what they once noticed.
At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
History carved in stone can become a warning for people who never saw the water rise.
It was evidence that water remembers low places, even when people build new roads over them.
